overview.description: The SoFi Social 50 Income ETF (SFYI) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in total market equity. The fund invests in SoFi Social 50 ETF (SFYF) or the companies it holds, while employing various options strategies. The actively managed ETF considers securities performance and market outlook in selecting options strategies to deploy. SFYI was launched on Jul 6, 2026 and is issued by SoFi.
